summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi BMNR 2x Daily ETF (BNMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of BitMine Immersion Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BMNR), through derivatives such as swaps. BNMC was launched on Jul 10, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
